notes.title: Update 2.0.12
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/00e220553b7915de7cde6b58481d9a8d53296953.png[/img]

[quote]On April 25 from 01:00 PT / 04:00 ET till 05:00 PT / 08:00 ET, the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy the 2.0.12 update.[/quote]

Update 2.0.12 marks the start of the final half of the Spring Campaign — the Red Comet special.

Allied air forces will deal a crippling blow to the German offensive in Europe which started during the Sword of Vengeance special. In Red Comet our players will get a chance to try new Soviet high-tier bombers — the Tupolev Tu-2, Tu-10, Tu-12 and Sukhoy Su-10. These fast, maneuverable machines are equipped with forward-facing armament and differ quite a bit from other bombers in the game. They are capable of not only crushing ground targets from high altitudes, but also pose considerable danger to enemy aircraft in aerial combat.

In-game visibility system has been changed to improve effectiveness of concealing paint schemes and Navigational Radio Equipment, as well as improve enemy detection ranges on maps with dense cloud cover.

Several crossings between branches in U.S.S.R., German and U.S.A. tech trees have been changed. Balance settings for a number of aircraft have been slightly tuned.

Additionally, we fixed multiple issues with maps, aircraft visuals in battle and Hangar.

[h1]New Aircraft[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/2a105be658b19d91dd9406840e8f47fd57098b08.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Tupolev Tu-2 — a Soviet Tier VII bomber;
[*] Tupolev Tu-10 — a Soviet Tier VIII bomber;
[*] Tupolev Tu-12 — a Soviet Tier IX bomber;
[*] Sukhoy Su-10 — a Soviet, Tier X bomber.
[/list]
The Tier VII-IX part of the U.S.S.R. bombers branch is represented by Tupolev Tu-2 and its successors the Tu-10 and Tu-12. These warplanes are quite similar in features and playstyle, with later models being in fact evolutions upon the most successful Soviet frontline bomber design of the World War II - the Tu-2. The concept of a bomber capable of aerial combat at low and medium altitudes due to powerful forward-facing and defensive armament is obvious in Tupolev machines. From Tier to Tier these aircraft gain improved flight characteristics but retain similar feel and playstyle.

The branch is crowned by the Sukhoy Su-10, also known as Product E. In contrast with the Tu-12 which was an intermediary design between piston-driven and jet-powered bombers, the Su-10 was initially conceived as a jet aircraft. It is faster, has better altitude performance, more powerful armament, and carries eight 500-kg bombs. Firepower from two twin-linked 20-mm cannons in its turrets will make attacking the Su-10 from rear hemisphere fatal for most fighters.

Tier VII-IX aircraft will be available through Special Orders that players can find in Trophies and complete during the Red Comet special. The Sukhoy Su-10 and its rival, the Junkers EF 131, will become available for research and purchase after the Spring Campaign is concluded, and all the players who participated and received multiple achievements in it will get a large discount to both XP and credit requirements. The full branch will become available for regular research after the Red Comet special. In the meantime the Su-10 and EF 131 can be encountered in battles piloted by bots.

[b]The following aircraft is now available for purchase in the premium shop:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ilyushin Il-1 — a Soviet Tier VI multirole fighter;
[*] Dornier Do 335 A-1 Pfeil — a German Tier VIII heavy fighter.
[/list]
[b]The following promotional aircraft has been added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bristol Beaufighter Mk V IM — a British Tier V heavy figher.
[/list]
[h1]Economy[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/e030de980b5c5ffd6f20330a359bcbdff8f10495.jpg[/img]

Reduced prices in experience for Tiers VIII-X aircraft upgrades:

[b]Tier VIII:[/b]
[list]
[*] 15% off the modules
[*] 25% off the aircraft
[/list]
[b]Tier IX:[/b]
[list]
[*] 20% off the modules
[*] 30% off the aircraft
[/list]
[b]Tier X:[/b]
[list]
[*] 25% off the modules
[*] 30% off the aircraft
[/list]

[h1]Balance[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/b724d00357f67d2f045d195ceb5c53db83843de7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Aircraft Balance Changes[/h1]

[b]Visibility changes[/b]
The settings of the aircraft visibility system have been changed in order to increase the utility of using concealing paint schemes, as well as the effect of the new Navigational Radio Equipment:

The use of seasonal concealing paint schemes (summer, winter, desert, marine) with the effect of +20% to aircraft concealment on the corresponding map types will reduce the distance of the aircraft's detection by an average of 200 m for aircraft of all Tiers. The use of Navigational Radio Equipment can further increase this effect up to 500 m. These changes will not influence other paint schemes' effects (protection from AA guns and gunners).
Clouds' concealment effect slightly decreased. This will increase the comfort of playing on maps with dense clouds. However, the clouds' concealment effect will remain quite significant and will reduce the detection distance by an average of 200 m.
In cases when there are no concealment effects and no crew skills or equipment increasing the view range, the detection range will be approximately 1,650 m for Tier I-IV aircraft, 2,000 m for Tier V-VII aircraft, and 2,500 m for Tier VIII-X aircraft. Like before, the detection range will be equal for all aircraft types.

Visible area on the Radar now covers 4500 / 3000 / 1500 meters for Tiers I-IV, 6000 / 4000 / 2000m for Tiers V-VII and 7500 / 5000 / 2500m for Tiers VIII-X. A circle visible on the radar when Alt is pressed represents average distance of enemy detection for the aircraft Tier. If an enemy is inside that circle it most probably can see the player's aircraft as well.

[h1]Flight model[/h1]

Aircraft behavior in stall has been changed. Stall will now become more controlled and easy to recover from.

[h1]Changes in tech trees[/h1]

[b]USSR[/b]
[list]
[*] Temporary crossing between bomber and attack aircraft branches between Pe-2 M-82 and Il-8 is no longer available.
[/list]
[h1]Germany[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fw 190 A-1 can now be researched from He 112 and Bf 109 E.
[*] Ta 152 can now be researched from Fw 190 D and Bf 109 G.
[/list]
[b]USA[/b]
[list]
[*] F6U can now be researched from P-51H and provides an cannon-based alternative to American fighters mostly armed with machineguns. It will also serve as a link for crossing over to the heavy fighter branch towards the F2H.
[/list]
[h1]Balance changes for some aircraft[/h1]

[b]USSR[/b]
[list]
[*] Il-20 — slightly reduced damage and blast radius of the TRS-82 rockets.
[*] RB-17 — all 4 engines can now be damaged individually.
[*] Il-40P — fixed an error in the turret damage settings for Specialist configuration. It will now deal more damage.
[/list]
[b]Germany[/b]
[list]
[*] Bf 109 G — increased armament accuracy, slightly increased boost efficiency and duration.
[/list]
[b]Great Britain[/b]
[list]
[*] Beaufighter — updated damage model, slightly decreased salvo duration for forward-facing armament.
[/list]
[h1]Game modes[/h1]

Settings for bomber waves in Escort game mode have been changed. Their HP count was increased for all battle Tiers. Numbers of bombers in waves and waves themselves have been rebalanced for all map layouts (increased for some and decreased for others).

[h1]New map layouts[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/e3ea545854d04af3b879e191b735fe91b1e26e01.jpg[/img]

Added 5 new map layouts based on Plateau map for Conquest game mode Tier VII-X battles:
[list]
[*] Surprise attack,
[*] Sandstorm,
[*] Cursed valley,
[*] Deserted fortress,
[*] Blazing sky.
[/list]
[h1]Paint schemes[/h1]

Added unique paint schemes for a number of aircraft from regular research trees to the Hangar "Paint Shop" tab.

These were previously only available as part of rewards for completing Special Orders or prizes for in-game events. Same as all the other non-concealing paint schemes, these provide +5% bonus to aircraft XP gain in battles.

The list of aircraft is as follows:
[list]
[*] Dornier Do 17 Z
[*] Junkers Ju 88 A
[*] Dornier Do 217 M
[*] Arkhangelsky/Tupolev SB
[*] Arkhangelsky Ar-2
[*] Petlyakov Pe-2
[*] Petlyakov Pe-2 M-82
[*] Boeing B-17D
[*] Boeing B-17G
[*] Consolidated B-32
[*] Kawasaki Ki-45
[*] Kawasaki Ki-102
[*] Rikugun Ki-93
[*] Hawker Tornado
[*] Hawker Typhoon
[*] Hawker Tempest
[*] Hawker Sea Hawk
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/8acfe469a7ff603db3e9023877bc9b38e58500bf.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused a respawn point different from the default one to revert to the default one in case the enemy team captured any allied territory while the player waited for respawn. It will now only revert to the default respawn point if the enemy team captures the territory selected for respawn.
[*] Fixed an incorrect spawn point for bombers on Northern Bridgehead: Cold Skies map layout so that they no longer spawn facing a mountain peak.
[*] Fixed an issue with AA guns not attacking enemies on several map layouts.
[*] Fixed an issue with Scorching Sands: Desert Strike map layout that caused one of the bombers to spawn among enemy team.
[*] Fixed engine power value for the Jumo 004A engine in the Hangar tooltip. Aircraft parameters have not changed.
[*] Fixed an issue with the XP-31 pilot model that caused the oxygen mask to shift in some cases.
[*] Fixed an issue with a reward paint scheme for the Hurricane Mk. I that caused its engine cover to lose metallic sheen.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused propeller speed visualization to not return to normal after engine critical damage and repair.
[*] Fixed a minor issue with the B-32 bomb bay doors animation.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.0.11.6
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/25bcee0bf794ad45c9afa5d21d5de6cdcd517716.jpg[/img]

The April update completes the first stage of the global Spring Campaign — the Blade of Vengeance operation. In a short period of calm before the beginning of the Allied forces' counterattack — the Red Comet operation, players will be able to take part in the secret tests of the first U.S.S.R. heavy fighter in the game — the Tupolev Tu-1. In addition, new personal ratings will be held within three weeks, with an opportunity to get unique pieces of equipment for both the Tu-1 and all aircraft of period II and III.

The update also adds a new type of equipment to the game — Navigational Radio Equipment, which increases visibility and decreases the range at which the aircraft is detected by enemy aircraft. First of all, this equipment will help aircraft without forward-firing weapons (bombers) avoid direct fire contact with enemy interceptors, making their way beyond their visibility.

[h1]Secret Trials: Tupolev Tu-1[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/1c9043f98365f3ee285b01d86b5c8215d28bdf3a.jpg[/img]

This update brings an opportunity to take part in the secret tests of the brand-new Tier VII U.S.S.R. heavy fighter — the Tupolev Tu-1. This is a heavily armed high-speed aircraft capable of destroying any target with several accurate volleys from its large-caliber guns. A powerful and clumsy "puncher", this heavy fighter is perfect for those who enjoy battles in air corridors. To add the Tupolev Tu-1 to your Hangar, you need to execute the special Secret Trials operation. You can activate it for free in the Supply Service. You can skip several operations or the whole chain by purchasing certificates in the Premium Shop. Also now, if the time for the operation execution has expired, but not all the missions have been completed, you can resume their execution using Tokens.

In addition, participation in the personal ratings will provide an opportunity to acquire unique Special Projects of the U.S.S.R. and the U.S.A. — equipment designed specifically for large heavily armed aircraft. This equipment increases the survivability and firepower of an aircraft. It is suitable for all aircraft of the corresponding period and is distinguished by significantly higher characteristics than its standard counterparts. Players who managed to get the Tu-1 in their Hangar will also be able to compete in the rating for getting a unique piece of equipment — the Tu-1 radar, which increases visibility and decreases the range at which the aircraft is detected by enemy and AA guns.

[h1]Personal Ratings[/h1]

Update 2.0.11.6 brings new in-game ratings.

By participating in battles and fulfilling the conditions for getting into the rating for each of the weeks, players will be located in one of five divisions and, on Wednesday, will receive prizes corresponding to their effectiveness — unique equipment, crews, and much more. Each of them will last for six days, from Thursday (16:00 UTC) till Tuesday (20:00 UTC).

[list]
[*] Week 1: Secret Trials: Armor Protection. Rating criteria for this week — critical damage caused to enemy aircraft. The main reward for participation will be some unique equipment — Special project of the U.S.S.R.: Engine Armor Protection. You can get this reward only by participating in the rating. Depending on the occupied division, players will receive equipment of various quality (from Stock to Ultimate), as well as mechanical parts, flight instruments, and gold. There will be two ratings — for Tier V-VII aircraft there will be a period II rating with period II equipment as a reward, and for Tier VIII+ aircraft there will be a similar period III rating. Players can take part in both ratings simultaneously.
[*] Week 2: Secret Trials: Weapons. Rating criteria — damage caused to aerial and ground targets. The main reward for participation will be some unique equipment — Special project of the U.S.S.R.: Long Gun Barrels. You can get this reward only by participating in the rating. Depending on the occupied division, players will receive equipment of various quality (from Stock to Ultimate), as well as weapon parts, heat-resistant parts, and gold. There will be two ratings — for Tier V-VII aircraft there will be a period II rating with period II equipment as a reward, and for Tier VIII+ aircraft there will be a similar period III rating. Players can take part in both ratings simultaneously.
[*] Week 3: Secret Trials: Turret. Rating criteria — number of personal points earned. The main reward for participation will be some unique equipment — Special project of the U.S.A: Turret Gunsight. You can get this reward only by participating in the rating. Depending on the occupied division, players will receive equipment of various quality (from Stock to Ultimate), as well as weapon parts, flight instruments, and gold. There will be three ratings — for Tier V-VII aircraft there will be a period II rating with period II equipment as a reward, for Tier VIII+ aircraft there will be a similar period III rating. There will also be a separate rating for players flying the Tu-1. Players in the third rating can receive the Tu-1 Radar and a Tu-1 gunner with 3-5 free skill points as a reward. Players can take part in all ratings simultaneously, the results of the battles with the Tu-1 will be simultaneously counted in the period II rating, since this is a Tier VII aircraft.
[/list]
[h1]New Aircraft[/h1]

[b]German Bombers[/b]
[list]
[*] Tier VII-IX aircraft of the German bombers branch (Ju 288A, Ju 288C, Ju 287) are now available for research and purchase via the Tech Tree.
[*] Tier X aircraft (EF 131) will be available for research and purchase after the end of the Red Comet event that will be held in May.
[/list]
[h1]New Special Reward Aircraft[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Tupolev Tu-1 — Tier VII U.S.S.R. heavy fighter.
[/list]
[h1]New Equipment[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/793edbf198cdcc063f391ed5f810b2a1fbb3d818.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Navigational Radio Equipment — enhances aircraft concealment and increases its view range from +5% up to +14.6%, decreases the pilot's resistance to injuries from 3% up to 11.4% depending on the quality and calibration degree. Gives additional bonuses when upgraded: increases concealment, firing accuracy, view range, and resistance to AA guns' damage. Mounted in the Cockpit slot. Available to purchase using credits. Can be mounted only on aircraft of period III.
[*] Tu-1 Radar — the Navigational Radio Equipment analogue that can be mounted only on the Tupolev Tu-1. You can receive it by taking part in the personal rating of the third week flying the Tu-1.
[*] Special project of the U.S.S.R.: Engine Armor Protection — an improved version of the common Engine Armor Protection equipment. Can be mounted in the Engine slot of period II and III aircraft. Increases engine resistance to critical damage and boosts top speed. Ultimate quality also increases hit points or reduces the chance of fire. You can get it only as a reward for participating in the personal ratings.
[*] Special project of the U.S.S.R.: Long Gun Barrels — an improved version of the common Long Gun Barrels equipment. Can be mounted in the forward-firing weapons slot of period II and III aircraft. Increases range of fire and burst length. Ultimate quality also increases the damage inflicted by forward-firing weapons or their fire accuracy. You can get it only as a reward for participating in the personal ratings.
[*] Special project of the U.S.A.: Turret Gunsight — an improved (lend-lease) version of the common Turret Gunsight equipment. Can be mounted in the Turret slot of period II and III aircraft. Increases the turret's range of fire in manual mode, and the gunner's resistance to injuries. Ultimate quality also increases the turret's damage or the chance to cause critical damage. You can get it only as a reward for participating in the personal ratings.
[/list]

[h1]Combat Reconnaissance[/h1]

Update 2.0.11 features a completely reworked tutorial and introduction system. Retaining the familiar Combat Reconnaissance name, the new system is much more detailed and accessible. It allow new and existing players to easily find out about all the important aspects of World of Warplanes from piloting to economics and aircraft improvement.

Combat Reconnaissance now contains 36 introductory missions, each of them accompanied by a brief review of various features of the game.

When the new mission is assigned or completed an information popup will appear in the Hangar. This can be disabled in the game settings menu if needed.

Completing the full Combat Reconnaissance set of missions will be rewarded with 1000 gold both for new players and for those who have already completed the old edition of the introductory course. The latter has been removed from the game and any stages of it are no longer available.

[h1]Maps[/h1]
Cold Peak: Piercing Wind map has been added for Tier VI-IX battles.

notes.title: Update 2.0.10
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/94da6d62e1c42ec8ece63265bf25afaf5422d75e.png[/img]

[b]On March 7 from 08:00 till 12:00 (UTC)[/b], the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy the 2.0.10 update.[/quote]

Update 2.0.10 introduces the deafening engine roar of high-tier German bombers. These aircraft follow the "Schnellbomber" concept – fast, high-altitude aircraft forcing their way through to targets and delivering their heavy bomb arsenal in the shortest time possible. You can receive the aircraft of Tier VII-IX during Blade of Vengeance event battles.

The Spring campaign will be continued by the Red Comet event in May. This event will logically continue the Blade of Vengeance plot, and introduce new additions to the branch of U.S.S.R. bombers.

Players, who actively participate in the two events and earn all the Spring campaign achievements, will receive an opportunity to purchase one of the brand-new Tier X bombers (EF 131 or Su-10E) at a special price after the Red Comet event ends.

In addition, this update introduces multiple balance changes in several game aspects: aircraft, game modes, maps, and much more. For example, the Conquest mode will become more dynamic for all players – you will spend more time in battles.

We fixed some significant bugs, and improved graphic effects for jet and piston-engine aircraft.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/1c9043f98365f3ee285b01d86b5c8215d28bdf3a.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Aircraft[/h1]

The final part of the German medium bombers branch is represented by aircraft designed and built by the Junkers company in Germany. 

These warbirds continue the Schnellbomber concept – fast aircraft carrying powerful bombs. The first two aircraft of the branch, the Ju 288A and Ju 288C, are an evolutionary development of the Do 217M high-altitude bomber in their character and capabilities. When it comes to the higher-tier aircraft, the nature of the German bombers changes radically: here you can find the Ju 287 and EF 131 jet-powered aircraft with a forward-swept wing. These vehicles bring fast and high-altitude gameplay.
[list]
[*]  Junkers Ju 288A, a German Tier VII bomber
[*]  Junkers Ju 288С, a German Tier VIII bomber
[*]  Junkers Ju 287, a German Tier IX bomber
[*]  Junkers EF 131, a German Tier X bomber
[/list]
[h1]The following aircraft is now available for purchase in the premium shop:[/h1]
[list]
[*]  Heinkel He 111 H-2, a German Tier IV bomber
[/list]
[h1]The following aircraft will be available only to developers and Supertest participants for testing purposes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]  Yak-7 М-82А, a Soviet Tier IV multirole fighter
[*]  Horten Ho 229, a German Tier VIII fighter
[/list]
You can receive the aircraft of Tier VII-IX during the Blade of Vengeance event. After the event ends, the whole branch except for the Tier X Junkers EF 131 will be available for research. 

With the release of Update 2.0.10, the transition between the branches of bombers and attack aircraft from the Do 217M to Me 265 will no longer be available.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/793edbf198cdcc063f391ed5f810b2a1fbb3d818.jpg[/img]

[h1]Balance[/h1]

[h1]Balance changes for some aircraft[/h1]
[b]Germany[/b]
[list]
[*] Me 265 – updated damage model, reduced the tailplane's susceptibility to critical damage.
[*] Me 329 – updated damage model, increased the burst length and accuracy of the 30 mm MK-108 guns, increased bomb reload speed, slightly reduced the turret's horizontal firing angles, increased maneuverability in pitch.
[*] Ме P.1099B – increased the burst length and accuracy of the standard 30 mm MK-108 guns, the improved turret mount no longer affects the speed.
[/list]
[b]U.S.S.R.[/b]
[list]
[*] IL-40 – slightly reduced the turret's horizontal firing angles, slightly reduced the forward-firing armament damage.
[*] IL-40P – slightly reduced the turret's horizontal firing angles.
[/list]
[b]U.K.[/b]
[list]
[*] Javelin – updated damage model, which will increase its survivability under fire.
[/list]
[b]Japan[/b]
[list]
[*] J8M – increased the accuracy and cooldown rate of the forward-firing armament, increased maneuverability at high speed, increased speed and maneuverability at high altitudes, improved the optimal speed, updated the damage model.
[/list]
[h1]Pilot Skills Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The pilot’s injury will now have a greater effect on the use of bombs and rockets. During a critical (red) injury, in addition to reducing accuracy, there will also be a slight decrease in the damage caused.
[*] The effect of the Demolition Expert skill on damage and blast radius has been reduced from + 15% to + 10%.
[/list]
[h1]Game Modes[/h1]
[b]Conquest:[/b]
[list]
[*] Activated the Group respawn mechanics. The queue time for respawn will take about 15-30 seconds.
[*] The number of times that the player's aircraft has been destroyed no longer affects the respawn time.
[*] The airbase no longer has the ability to reduce the queue time for respawn.
[*] The Arctic Region: Winter War map layout is now available only for Tier II-IV battles.
[*] The Arctic Region: Ancient Hill map layout is now available only for Tier III-IV battles.
[*] The Cold Peak: Gem of the Mountain map layout is now available only for Tier VI battles.
[/list]
[h1]Invasion[/h1]
[list]
[*] The battle tier range for most map layouts has been changed from 4 to 2.
[*] Added 3 new map layouts: Arctic Region: Night raid (battle Tiers IV-V), Cold Peak: Risky attempt (battle Tiers VII-VIII), and Alpine Gambit: Forgotten garrison (battle Tiers VIII-IX).
[*] Improved some map layouts that were previously removed from the list of available ones: territories replaced, entry points were added or replaced as well for some map layouts.
[*] Activated the Group respawn mechanics at 40-second intervals.
[*] For some map layouts, the individual number of respawns available to teams has been configured.
[/list]
[b]Bomber Escort:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the number of bombers departing in different waves.
[/list]
[h1]Matchmaker[/h1]
[list]
[*] In the Conquest and Attrition modes, the maximum number of aircraft belonging to the PvE-class (bombers and attack aircraft) was reduced to 4 per team.
[*] In the Invasion and Escort modes, the maximum number of aircraft belonging to the PvE-class (bombers and attack aircraft) has been reduced to 5 for the attacking team.
[*] Added separate matchmaker settings for new players. If the players earned less than 4,000 XP in the game, they will get into battles, where the entire enemy team consists of Bots.
[/list]
[h1]Aircraft Type-Specific Missions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Two aircraft type-specific missions for heavy fighters were replaced with new ones. The respective achievements were added.
[/list]
[h1]Bots[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed the aiming system for Bots in order to increase their effectiveness against poorly maneuvering targets. Speaking about actively maneuvering targets, the Bot's firing effectiveness will remain unchanged or slightly decrease.
[*] Slightly reduced the territory type influence on the priorities of Bots. Now they will be less likely to choose more prioritized, but remote sectors, when the nearest ones are not captured.
[/list]
[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated the sounds of jet aircraft engines. Single, double and multi-engine jet aircraft will now sound different.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/8acfe469a7ff603db3e9023877bc9b38e58500bf.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the lack of graphic effects for a jet blast for some aircraft.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the display of propellers did not change when flying at an extreme altitude (engines did not stall visually).
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the player's camera in the Sniper mode could stop changing its position in space with the movement of the aircraft.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a black screen after the end of the countdown before the battle or reentering the battle.
[*] Fixed a critical game client error when launching the game on Steam with a Steam Controller connected.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.0.9.6
notes.content:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TX3729-ScQU][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/3c408e9eae1fd8576b37966003c962f3d9e5e024.jpg[/img][/url]

[quote]NA
[b]On January 31 from 00:00 PT / 03.00 ET till 04:00 PT / 07:00 ET[/b], the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy the 2.0.9.6 update.[/quote]

[quote]EU
[b]On January 31 from 08:00 till 12:00 (UTC)[/b], the servers will undergo maintenance to deploy the 2.0.9.6 update.[/quote]

This update introduces the possibility to add the Blohm und Voss BV.203 to your Hangar, in-game ratings, and:

[h1]New Aircraft[/h1]
The following aircraft are now available for purchase in the in-game shop:

☆  Tachikawa Ki-94-I, Japanese Tier VII heavy fighter,
☆  P-80A-1 Shooting Star, American Tier VIII fighter.

[h1]New Special aircraft:[/h1]

☆  Blohm und Voss BV P.203, German Tier VIII heavy fighter.

[h1]Aircraft Balance Changes[/h1]
This update’s balance changes are aimed at increasing the dynamics of Tier I-II aircraft, increasing the effectiveness of basic (stock) configurations, and adjusting some aircraft characteristics.

[h1]U.S.S.R.[/h1]
[list]
[*]  I-5 — increased cruise speed, improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers, reduced accuracy in the configuration with 4 machine guns, rocket accuracy slightly increased.
[*] I-7, I-15, I-5 ShKAS, I-15bis DM, TsKB-12bis, I-16 (early mod.), DI-6i — improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers.
[*] TSh-2 — increased speed and maneuverability, increased the range of fire and damage of the outboard PV-1 machine guns.
[*] TSh-3 — slightly increased maneuverability, increased damage of the PV-1 stock machine guns.
[*] Pe-2, Pe-2 M-82 — changed the outboard bombs’ effect on the aircraft speed. The use of Aerodynamic Pylons will now increase the speed of these aircraft by up to 20 km/h.
[/list]
[h1]Germany[/h1]
[list]
[*] Ar 65 — increased cruise speed, improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers, slightly increased the range of fire and damage of the MG-08/18 stock machine guns.
[*] Ar 67, Fw 56, He 51, Fi 98, Hs 123, Ha 137, Ha 137 V1, Fw 189 C — improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers.
[*] Ar 68 — improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers, decreased the accuracy of the MG-08/18 wing-mounted machine guns.
[*] Аo 192 — increased speed and controllability, increased the accuracy of the forward-firing machine guns, increased the range of fire and damage of the MG-08/18 stock machine guns, slightly decreased hit points.
[/list]
[h1]U.S.A.[/h1]
[list]
[*] P-12 — increased cruise speed and maneuverability in pitch, improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers.
[*] P-23, F2F, P-26, F11C-2, F3F — improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers.
[/list]
[h1]Japan[/h1]
[list]
[*] Type-91 — increased cruise speed, improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers.
[*] A4N, Ki-10, Ki-5, Ki-8, Ki-18, A5M, Ki-27, Ki-33 — improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers.
[/list]
[h1]U.K.[/h1]
[list]
[*] Goldfinch — increased cruise speed and maneuverability in pitch, improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers, slightly decreased bomb reload speed, decreased the ejector rack's impact on speed.
[*] Demon — increased accuracy of the forward-firing machine guns and maneuverability in pitch, improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers, slightly decreased bomb reload speed, decreased the ejector rack's impact on speed.
[*] Type 224 — improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers.
[/list]
[h1]France[/h1]
[list]
[*] S.510 — improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers
[/list].
[h1]China[/h1]
[list]
[*] Hawk II, Hawk III — increased cruise speed, improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers. Ba.27M — improved speed preservation when performing maneuvers.
[/list]

[h1]The Secret Trials event[/h1]
The 2.0.9.6 update will allow players to take part in the secret tests of [b]the Blohm und Voss BV.203[/b], the experimental German Tier VIII heavy fighter, and the unique equipment for this and other aircraft.

BV.203 — a typical representative of the Blohm und Voss's non-standard approach to aircraft design.

It is equipped with a hybrid power unit:

Two piston-type engines provide decent thrust when cruising, and two jet engines guarantee great acceleration when boosting. The combination of a pair of large-caliber guns and four large-caliber machine guns guarantee high firepower at all fire rates and the ability to destroy almost any target in one pass.

To add the Blohm und Voss BV.203 to your Hangar, you need to execute the special Secret Trials operation. You can purchase this operation in the Supply Service.

You may skip several operations or the whole chain of operations by purchasing certificates in the Premium Shop.

In addition, participation in the personal ratings will provide an opportunity to acquire the unique special projects of Germany — equipment developed by German engineers specifically for heavily-armed, high-speed aircraft.

It is suitable for all aircraft of the corresponding period and is distinguished by significantly higher characteristics than its standard counterparts.

[h1]Personal Ratings[/h1]

Update 2.0.9.6 brings new in-game ratings.

By participating in battles and fulfilling the conditions for getting into the rating for each week, players will be located in one of five divisions and, on Wednesday, will receive prizes corresponding to their effectiveness — unique equipment, crews, and much more.

[h1]Optimization and Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Optimized the work of the game client with RAM and some graphic effects, which should increase performance on all graphics settings.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a sharp increase in memory consumption by the game client when loading a battle while the game window was minimized to the desktop.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the client would crash when quickly switching between aircraft in the Spectator mode.
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the total number of Personal Points earned did not match on the Battle Results screen and in the end of battle system notification.
[/list]

notes.title: Mission Possible: The XP-55 and De Havilland Vampire in Exchange for Tokens
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/010ddda7a1f33e074c79e2500efa997c50be562a.jpg[/img]

Update 2.0.9 brings a unique opportunity to get the Curtiss-Wright XP-55 Ascender and de Havilland Vampire F.1 by completing a chain of missions.

[h1]The de Havilland Vampire F.1[/h1] is a high-speed and very maneuverable British Tier VIII jet fighter for dogfighting that performs most effectively at mid altitude. Its armament allows for effectively fighting against any enemy aircraft at close- and mid-range. This combination makes the Vampire F.1 a universal aircraft capable of utilizing successful tactics against any opponent, using either its speed or maneuverability advantages (it’s up to the pilot).

[h1]The Curtiss-Wright XP-55 Ascender[/h1] is a highly maneuverable and dynamic American fighter with accurate machine guns. It is the perfect choice for mid-altitude high-speed combat. Its four large-caliber machine guns are capable of delivering sustained fire without overheating. The XP-55 Ascender shows excellent performance in intense battles and can fight on par with its opponents.

[h1][b]How to Catch a Rare Bird[/b][/h1]
Log into the game and select your desired plane, then complete the missions whenever you want—there is no time limit. Once your choice is made, leap into action to get your well-deserved reward. Mission progress is displayed in the Personal Missions section where you can always keep track of your current stage.

The icing on the cake is the unique achievements awarded for completing all missions in a chain.
[table]
[tr]
[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/e510eff5c7053818f4348c5874de0247440fde57.png[/img]
[/td]
[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/47f30582227345380431be1ea0d5449c82dc2e5a.png[/img]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[b][h1]Tough Decision?[/h1][/b]
If you feel like testing your skills in completing missions for the other aircraft at any point, don’t worry — the progress of already completed missions will be saved and you won't have to start from scratch. You can switch between the chains of missions. However, you will not be able to fulfill missions for both aircraft at the same time: only one chain of mission can be active at a time.

[b][h1]Facing a Difficult Mission?[/h1][/b]
You can skip any mission in a chain using tokens! To get tokens, complete daily missions and earn Epic Achievements, Tiered Decorations, and Service Awards.

Tokens are awarded for:
[list]
[*] Accomplishing three parts of each daily mission. The number of tokens depends on the difficulty of a daily mission.
[*] You get one token for each Epic Achievement or Tiered Decoration, or one of the following Service Awards: Ace, Winged Legend, Thunder, or Hero of the Sky. Tokens are only awarded for the first time you get an achievement each day.
[/list]
In addition, you can purchase tokens using gold during the last week of each month at a rate of 1 token = 50 gold.

notes.title: Update 2.0.9
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/cd51e7e3adb587f9cc481961478e916f8d0344ee.jpg[/img]

Update 2.0.9 introduces new aircraft to World of Warplanes, balance and game mode changes, new opportunities to speed up the path to the best vehicles in the game, and, of course, the Christmas Event.

Fans of intense aerial combat might enjoy the new British multirole Hawker line as the key features of these aircraft are their high speed and powerful weapons. New boosters, in turn, allow players to get increased rewards for their efforts — earn even more credits and experience to make the most of every battle! Attack aircraft pilots might like the new opportunity to manually reload outboard weapons. This feature will guarantee that you will be fully armed when flying to any target. In addition, with this update release, all players get the chance to receive two unique Premium aircraft by completing special chains of missions available in the Supply Service.

[h1]Operation Holiday Maneuvers[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/167c1707327ab3359c1d57b16117d65b33b2c9ef.jpg[/img]

The Operation Holiday Maneuvers event will run [b]from December 20 to January 16 15:00 PT / 18:00 ET.[/b] By advancing along the holiday route, players receive valuable Christmas gifts. Among the main prizes are aircraft from the new branch of British multirole fighters (The Hawker Typhoon, Hawker Tempest, and Hawker Sea Hawk), a pilot for the Hawker Typhoon with 5 skill points, a pilot for the Hawker Sea Hawk with 9 skill points, holiday paint schemes and decorations for these vehicles, as well as the Premium British fighter Hawker P.V.3 with a unique pilot Rudolf Hawker. When flying on the Hawker P.V.3, the unique pilot puts on a holiday mask and his plane leaves festive trails in the sky.

Advancing along the marathon route depends directly on the amount of Candy you have. Every Candy piece you earn moves you closer to the coveted reward! Candy can be earned for effective actions in battles and rewarded for completing daily missions. It is also possible to move faster and skip all stages using certificates. If players earn more Candy than is necessary to receive all holiday gifts, the remaining Candy will be converted into Free Experience at a rate of 50 points of Free Experience for 1 Candy.

Event gifts also include some very unusual ones, such as bear, eagle, deer, and squirrel sculptures. Decorating your Hangar with ice sculptures grants unique bonuses to all aircraft on your account in battle. The bonuses are durability, speed, maneuverability, and experience earned in battles. Once ice sculptures are put in the Hangar, their bonuses will be active till the end of the Operation Holiday Maneuvers event.

3 unique holiday achievements will help you keep warm memories about this winter. These achievements can only be obtained during the event.

Aircraft received during the event cannot be sold before the end of the event.

[h1]Santa's Bag[/h1]
During the winter holidays, players can treat themselves to holiday bags with prizes or send gifts to their friends. Santa’s bags include Premium aircraft, gold, Free Experience, days of Premium account, and materials to enhance, calibrate, or reassemble equipment. All players who receive a bag of prizes will also receive the Santa's Bag 2019 achievement.

[h1]New aircraft[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/1c9043f98365f3ee285b01d86b5c8215d28bdf3a.jpg[/img]

The continuation of the British Hawker multirole fighters’ line was added. Fast and well-adapted for aerial combat, these aircraft are armed with powerful autocannons and rockets.
[list]
[*] Hawker Typhoon — UK, Tier VII multirole fighter;
[*] Hawker Tempest — UK, Tier VIII multirole fighter;
[*] Hawker Sea Hawk — UK, Tier IX multirole fighter;
[*] Hawker Hunter — UK, Tier X multirole fighter.
[/list]
Planes of Tiers VII–IX can be received during the Operation Holiday Maneuvers event. After the event is over, the full branch will be available for research and purchase, and the Tier X plane will be added to the tech tree. Up to this moment, the Hawker Hunter can be met in battles as an airplane under AI control.

With the release of Update 2.0.9, the transition from the Tornado to the Spitfire Mk. IX will no longer be available.

[h1]New promotional planes added:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Curtiss-Wright XP-55 Ascender — USA, Tier VI fighter;
[*] Hawker P.V.3 — UK, Tier III fighter.
[/list]
[h1]Aircraft available only to developers and participants of the Supertest for testing:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tupolev Tu-1 — USSR, Tier VII heavy fighter.
[/list]
[h1]Game Mode Changes[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/793edbf198cdcc063f391ed5f810b2a1fbb3d818.jpg[/img]

[b]Anti-Aircraft Guns[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the damage of anti-aircraft guns by 10-20% at all battle tiers to aircraft of all types, except for bombers.
[*] The effectiveness of high-altitude anti-aircraft guns against bombers remains the same.
[/list]
[b]Command Center[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the time between bomber flight launches by 10 seconds.
[/list]
[b]Game schemes[/b]
[list]
[*] The asymmetric game scheme "Albion: Wings of War" has been disabled to undergo improvement.
[*] Changed the battle entry point of the top team on the asymmetric game scheme "Archipelago: Decisive blow."
[/list]
[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

[b]Aircraft balance adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the turret aiming time from 2 seconds to 3 seconds. For the B-32, it is 4 seconds. For fighters and multirole fighters with turrets, it is 1 second.
[*] Reduced the damage from turrets at maximum distance. The probability of critical damage and the effectiveness of fire at maximum distance have not changed.
[*] Increased the flight range of the HVAR Mk.25 (F2H, F-84F, F7F, F2G, XP-72, F-84B) and RP-3 GP (Seafang, P. 1056, P. 228) rockets.
[*] Fixed the overestimated value of the time delay for bomb detonation of the B-17D, B-17G, and B-32. Now it is the same as the time delay for the other bombers.
[*] Slightly increased the time delay for bomb detonation of the Pe-2 and Pe-2 M-82. Now these aircraft perform better and are safer at low altitude.
[/list]
[b]Equipment changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the effectiveness of universal ammunition for forward-firing weapons available using credits when shooting at armored ground targets. Now this ammunition will be more effective in attacking ground targets.
[/list]
[b]Tail Gunner skills[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the effect of the “Armorer” skill on the turret burst length from +20% to +50%.
[*] Reduced the effect of the “Ballistics Expert” skill on the turret range of fire from +20% to +10%.
[/list]
[h1]Particular aircraft model changes[/h1]

[b]Germany[/b]
[list]
[*] Ta-152 — decreased yaw rate, rate of cooling, and firing accuracy at small maneuvering targets for MK-103 guns.
[/list]
[b]USA[/b]
[list]
[*] XF5U — decreased pitch and yaw rate, increased roll rate. Slightly increased stall speed, decreased boost duration, but slightly increased the speed of boost duration recovery. Decreased range of fire, accuracy, and rate of cooling of M39 guns. Increased time of engine recovery after critical damage.
[/list]
[b]Japan[/b]
[list]
[*] Ki-94-I — increased optimal altitude and service ceiling, increased boost climb rate.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]UK[/b]
[*] Tornado — decreased pitch rate and burst length, slightly increased tail’s resistance to critical damage, and decreased wings’ resistance to critical damage.
[/list]
[h1]New consumables[/h1]
Added a new type of consumable — boosters. Boosters provide a significant increase to rewards earned in battle for a short time. The following types of boosters are available:
[list]
[*] Upgrade Implementation — aircraft experience +100%. This consumable also increases all derivatives of aircraft experience — Crew Experience and Free Experience.
[*] Intensive Training — Crew Experience +300%.
[*] Air Reconnaissance — Free Experience +300%.
[*] Procurement System Improvement — credits +100%.
[/list]
Each booster is available in two versions: for 1 hour of real (not gaming) time for 150 gold, or for 2 hours of real time for 200 gold. If the game server is unavailable or under maintenance, activated boosters will be compensated.

Boosters can be purchased and activated in the upper left corner of the Hangar, in the account menu.

[b]“Ground Verification”[/b] consumables on players’ accounts are converted into one-hour “Procurement System Improvement” boosters at a rate of 1 booster for 3 units of consumables.

[b]“Aerial Verification”[/b] consumables on players’ accounts are converted into one-hour “Upgrade Implementation” boosters at a rate of 1 booster for 3 units of consumables.

When converting, the number of accrued boosters is rounded in favor of the players. For example, for 4 units of old consumables, the player will receive 2 boosters.

[h1]Premium Aircraft for tokens[/h1]

Added the possibility to get unique Premium aircraft (the Vampire F.1 and XP-55) by completing special chains of missions. These chains of missions can be activated for free in the Supply Service. Missions that are included in the chains are not time-limited. They can also be completed using Tokens.

[h1]New equipment[/h1]

Added a new type of equipment — “Aerodynamic Pylons”. This equipment drastically reduces the effect of the equipped outboard weapons on the aircraft’s speed. It is perfectly suited for multirole and heavy fighters, allowing them to deliver precision strikes against ground targets, while maintaining maximum readiness for aerial combat. Improved “Aerodynamic Pylons” can also be obtained by taking part in the holiday event.

"Aerodynamic pylons" are available only for Periods II and III.

[h1]Other changes[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/8acfe469a7ff603db3e9023877bc9b38e58500bf.jpg[/img]

[b]Changes in equipment[/b]

"Rocket Sight" is now available for aircraft of Period I.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the sound of the countdown to respawn could continue playing for a while after respawning.
[*] Fixed an issue where the radius of the bombsight did not return to its original state after the pilot recovered from injury.
[*] Fixed an issue where the tail gunner stopped firing at low-flying aircraft if there were ground or mountains behind this aircraft.
[*] Fixed an issue where bombs were not replenished after respawning.
[*] Fixed an issue with the incorrect location of the turrets on the damage model of the Pe-2, Pe-2 M-82, SB, and Ar-2.
[*] Added the ability to assign keys for the fourth equipment slot in the “Joystick” menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where the amount of experience needed to improve bombs on a B-17D was zero. Players who already have this aircraft with equipped improved bombs will receive this improvement for free. Players who purchase the B-17D after the release of Update 2.0.9 and players who have not equipped improved bombs on the aircraft before the update’s release will need to research them.
[*] Fixed an issue where the target lock did not work after changing aircraft at the Airfield.
[*] Fixed an issue where bombs might stop replenishing after changing the RB-17 to another aircraft at the Airfield.
[*] Fixed problems with displaying bomber flight icons on the battle interface.
[/list]
[b]Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] ADA’s models have been optimized to improve the performance of the game client.
[/list]
[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to manually reload the incomplete loading of the outboard weapons by pressing the "V" key. This process takes as much time as fully reloading the outboard weapons. Pressing the “V” key again while the outboard weapons are already reloading does not start it again. When reloading is not needed, pressing the reload key is ignored. If several types of outboard weapons are used simultaneously, the most consumed one will be reloaded first.
[*] Added new animations for receiving supply crates and prizes from them. When opening several crates in a row, you can skip the animation by clicking the left mouse button.
[*] Disabled several daily missions that were exceedingly difficult to complete, pending rework and improvement. All players who had those daily missions active will have them automatically replaced.
[*] Added new graphic effects for muzzle flashes, tracers, and hits for all ammunition types. They can now be easily discerned in battle and players can take appropriate evasive action depending on the danger to their aircraft.
[/list]

notes.title: Server Downtime: Update 2.0.8.4
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/1eaba3024a71c2085b877e5cd9be27370b2a31d2.jpg[/img]

Meet Update 2.0.8.4 for World of Warplanes.

[quote]NA
Please note: In order to deploy the latest update, the servers will undergo maintenance on [b]December 4 from 23:00 PT / December 5 02:00 ET till December 5 04:00 PT / 07:00 ET[/b][/quote]

[quote]
In order to deploy the latest update, the servers will undergo maintenance [b]on December 5 from 08:00 CET till 13:00 CET (UTC +1)[/b]. Thank you for your patience.[/quote]

[h1]New Aircraft[/h1]
[list]
[*] The branches of the recently added U.S. heavy bombers (B-17D, B-17G, and B-32) and Japanese heavy fighters (Ki-45, Ki-102, and Ki-95) are now available for research and purchase in the Tech Tree.
[*] The branch of U.S. heavy bombers forks from the Tier V P-44 multirole fighter, starts with the Tier V B-17D bomber, and ends with the B-32 bomber joining the Tier VII P-47N multirole fighter.
[*] The branch of Japanese heavy fighters forks from the Tier IV Ki-43-I and A6M1 fighters, starts with the Ki-45 heavy fighter, and ends with the Ki-93 heavy fighter joining the Tier VIII Ki-94-II fighter and the Tier VIII J7W1 multirole fighter.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug that prevented one of the emblems of the Vickers Venom from providing a bonus.
[*] Changed the descriptions of the key features of Japanese heavy fighters in the aircraft specifications panel in the Hangar.
[*] Fixed the bug where damaged modules of some bombers were not displayed correctly in the aircraft layout in the battle interface.
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed the Premium Account maximum duration limit. Now players who have reached the maximum Premium Account duration will be able to receive rewards extending its duration.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.0.8
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/1210e5fadb85df2ade823a2e275c9d91fa608aa9.png[/img]

[quote]NA
In order to deploy the latest update, the servers will undergo maintenance on November 8 from 00:00 PT / 03.00 ET till 04:00 PT / 07:00 ET[/quote]

[quote]EU
In order to deploy Update 2.0.8, the servers will undergo maintenance on [b]8 November at 09:00 CET until 13:00 CET (UTC +1)[/b]. Thank you for your patience.[/quote]

[b]Update 2.0.8[/b] introduces two brand new tech tree branches to World of Warplanes—the huge and destructive American Flying Fortresses and the extremely dangerous Japanese heavy fighters to counter them. Feel the deafening roar of powerful engines and the rumble of heavy weapons.

In addition, with the release of the update, new ratings start. All active players now have the opportunity to take part in the ratings while fighting in battles and receive valuable prizes based on the rating results.

[h1]Early access to new aircraft[/h1]
[b]From November 8 till December 5[/b], players will have the chance to add the new planes to their Hangar first by participating in the event. 

Drop by the Supply Service ("Tokens" Menu in your Hangar) and buy Operation Orders for the six new aircraft, complete the series of missions given to be able to conquer the skies in your brand new bomber or heavy fighter without the need to research and purchase them.

Remember that you can get Tokens for completing Daily missions and receiving the most valuable medals in battles. In addition, during the event there will be the opportunity to buy Tokens using gold on weekends.

[h1]New aircraft[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/01bea8f02a95c661a02a7b56d4c02f693faab413.jpg[/img]

[b]USA bomber line[/b]

Not very maneuverable, but incredibly strong and well-protected aircraft with high survivability, loaded with a huge stock of large caliber bombs. These aircraft are perfectly suited for the rapid capture of well-protected sectors with a large number of objects. In a single pass, these machines can easily destroy a huge number of targets, and then, on their way back, complete the task and wipe out the enemy’s buildings. In air combat, the most powerful turrets with reliable overlapping sectors of fire provide excellent protection against enemy fighters—any target at close range will be full of holes in a matter of seconds.
[list]
[*] Boeing B-17D — USA, Tier V bomber;
[*] Boeing B-17G — USA, Tier VI bomber;
[*] Consolidated B-32 — USA, Tier VII bomber. [/list]

[b]Japan heavy fighters line[/b]

Maneuverable heavy fighters with powerful heavy weapons, bombs, and turret gunners. Thanks to effective forward-firing and outboard weapons, these aircraft can be used to break through ground and air defense of sectors, resist bomber raids, and intercept attack aircraft. In air combat, their powerful large-caliber weapons are especially effective against large targets, but good handling and maneuverability make it possible to counter light fighters.
[list]
[*] Kawasaki Ki-45 Toryu — Japan, Tier V heavy fighter;
[*] Kawasaki Ki-102 — Japan, Tier VI heavy fighter;
[*] Rikugun Ki-93 — Japan, Tier VII heavy fighter.[/list]

[b]New promotional planes added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Curtiss XP-36F — USA, Tier IV fighter;
[/list]
[b]Aircraft available only to developers and participants of the Supertest for testing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Curtiss-Wright XP-55 Ascender — USA, Tier VI fighter.
[*] Blohm und Voss BV P.203 — Germany, Tier VIII heavy fighter.[/list]

[h1]Aircraft balance adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the overall accuracy of the high-altitude bombing of bombers. Decreased the accuracy of bombing directly at the very upper limit of the optimal altitude. 
[*] Updated the damage models for the following aircraft: XP-36F, P-36C, P-36, Hawk 75, P-40, P-40 M-105, Tomahawk IIb, Model 81A-1, Yak-1, Yak-1M, Yak-3, Yak-3RD, Yak-3Т, Yak-7, Yak-9, Yak-9U, Yak-15.[/list]

[h1]Personal ratings[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/b724d00357f67d2f045d195ceb5c53db83843de7.jpg[/img]

New ratings start with the release of the update. Each of them will last for six days from [b]15:00 PT / 18:00 ET - Tue 19:00 PT / 22:00 ET[/b]. By taking part in battles and meeting the conditions of the rating entrance for each of the weeks, players will be placed into one of the divisions and, on Wednesdays, receive prizes according to their effectiveness.
[list]
[*] Week 1: [b]National ratings.[/b] Only Tier IV+ aircraft take part in the ratings. The criterion for entering the ratings this week is the number of personal points earned by players in battles on aircraft of all nations present in the game except for France and China. The prizes for participating depending on the division will be gunners of corresponding nations with free skill points, equipment for aircraft with outboard weapons, and—for participants of the higher divisions—gold. Players can participate in all 5 national ratings simultaneously.
[*] Week 2: [b]Aircraft type ratings.[/b] Only Tier IV+ aircraft take part in the ratings. The criterion for entering the ratings this week is the number of destroyed aerial and/or ground targets depending on the type of aircraft. The prizes for participating depending on the division will be ultimate and advanced equipment, rare materials for calibration and enhancement, and—for participants of the higher divisions—gold. Players can participate in all 5 aircraft type ratings simultaneously.
[*] Week 3: [b]Aircraft tier ratings.[/b] All tiers of aircraft can participate. The criterion for entering the ratings this week is the number of times the player placed among the top 3 ranks in the combat group. The prizes for participating depending on the division will be Tokens, free XP, and gold. Players can participate in all 4 ratings simultaneously (Tiers I-II, III-IV, V-VII и VIII-X).[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/8acfe469a7ff603db3e9023877bc9b38e58500bf.jpg[/img]

[h1]Matchmaker[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased time for matchmaker to attempt balancing a single flight in the battle queue with another flight.
[*] Increased time for matchmaker to attempt balancing a single player in the battle queue with another one before launching a battle against bots.
[*] Reduced the maximum total difference in player aircraft Tiers in battles that include 3vs3 players or more to 2 Tiers instead of 3. Now player aircraft in battles will be more balanced.[/list]

[h1]Interface[/h1]

[b]Hangar[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the number of bombs and rockets used per one launch to the description of the bomb and rocket modules.
[*] Improved the descriptions of bombers according to the optimal tactics of their usage: precision altitude bombing, area bombardment with the use of a large number of bombs, possibility of dive bombing. [/list]

[b]Other changes[/b]
Improved a number of internal interface mechanics to reduce performance drops caused by them during battles.

[h1]Blériot-SPAD S.510[/h1]
The Blériot-SPAD S.510 is a French Tier II biplane fighter that features four machine guns located under the wings, unusual for a biplane, capable of providing high-density fire in a dogfight. Like all other Premium aircraft, this fighter earns an increased amount of credits per battle.

[h1]TsKB I-7[/h1]
The TsKB I-7 is a rare Soviet Tier II fighter that was designed in Germany, but saw mass production in the U.S.S.R.

[h1]Polikarpov I-15bis DM-2[/h1]
The Soviet Tier III Polikarpov I-15bis DM-2 fighter combines a biplane configuration and jet-powered engines, high maneuverability and powerful boost, rapid-firing armament and an increased credit income.

[h1]Curtiss Model 81A-1[/h1]
The American Tier IV Curtiss Model 81A-1 fighter is an early version of the American P-40. It is superior to most aircraft in its tier in speed. With its good horizontal maneuverability, machine gun armament that’s effective in close combat, and an increased credit income, you can join any battle and bring order to the skies.

[h1]Kawasaki Ki-88[/h1]
The Kawasaki Ki-88 is a Japanese high-altitude interceptor with a formidable armament. Hurry to strap into the Ki-88 and dominate the higher altitudes!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/6733a2f9102dfb52a350289fc315146684a0dc93.png[/img] [b]Spitfire Mk Ia[/b] was the only Allied aircraft capable of fighting on par with the German Messerschmitt Bf 109 E in May 1940. In the game, this aircraft features excellent maneuverability in turns. Its multiple rapid-firing machine guns prove very effective at close range.

This British fighter is controlled by the pilot [h1][b]Charles Donovan[/b][/h1]
[table]
[tr]
[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/402cb350fa6728a9032e52e7e2d158f23426dcb8.png[/img]
[/td]
[td]Universal (passive) skill [b]"Spitfire Mk Ia Master"[/b]. Increases maneuverability and damage of forward-firing offensive armament by 10%. This skill replaces the "Protection Expert" skill and takes effect only on the Spitfire Mk Ia.
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/9cce598011904f4740ab08f93d912e6180c7b1c2.png[/img]
[/td]
[td]Special (active) skill [b]"Final Dash"[/b]. Repairs all critical damage, heals all crew injuries, makes the pilot more resistant to injury, and increases maneuverability and engine thrust by 10% when the aircraft loses 50% of its hit points. This skill is activated automatically once per battle and remains effective until the end of the battle. This skill replaces the "Resilience" skill.
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/6733a2f9102dfb52a350289fc315146684a0dc93.png[/img] [b]Messerschmitt Bf 109 E-3[/b] proved to be the best German fighter in the French Campaign of 1940 and surpassed any fighter of the Allies. Only the Supermarine Spitfire Mk I could match the Bf 109 E-3 in battle. In the game, the Bf 109 E-3 displays its strengths most effectively in vertical and high-altitude combat where it can also apply its excellent diving abilities and high firepower.

This German aircraft is controlled by the pilot [h1][b]Hans Weber[/b][/h1]
[table]
[tr]
[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/be409de791b29a2bfbc701dbdbd3a4f21d726dba.png[/img]
[/td]
[td]Universal (passive) skill [b]"Bf 109 E-3 Master"[/b]. Increases airspeed and damage of forward-firing offensive armament by 10%. This skill replaces the "Protection Expert" skill and takes effect only on the Bf 109 E-3.
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/bf5eca0a5dce91f4c8de7fb4a3b83182cfc4fdc0.png[/img]
[/td]
[td]Special (active) skill [b]"Nosedive"[/b]. Increases damage of forward-firing offensive armament by 10%, and the chance of setting an enemy aircraft on fire and causing critical damage by 50% when firing with forward-firing weapons in a diving attack. Takes effect when the aircraft speed approaches maximum dive speed and pitch angle exceeds 45°. This skill replaces the "Raptor Strike" skill.
[/td]
[/tr]

[h1]Matchmaker[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the minimum waiting time for players queued for battle until the matchmaker launches a battle with the opposing team fully comprised of bots.

[h1]Escort game mode[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed the number of bombers in waves (variable for different map layouts).
[*] Changed the number of respawns for players (variable for different map layouts).

[*] Changed the requirements for aircraft type-specific missions in the Escort game mode.
[/list]
[h1]Conquest game mode[/h1]
[list]
[*] Map layouts on the Cold Peak map are now available for battles at Tiers VI-IX (up from Tiers V-VIII).
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the rear gunner of the Ju 86E to stand in his turret while in flight.
[*] Fixed a rare issue that caused bomber flights in the Conquest mode to target allied sectors.
[/list]

notes.title: Bomber Escort Game Mode
notes.content:
In the new Bomber Escort game mode you have to fight for one of the sides: escorting group or intercepting group. The goals and missions of the teams are completely opposite. The aim of the escorting group is to escort waves of strategic bombers across enemy territory, which is defended by the intercepting group.

[h1]Game Mode Video[/h1]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mt-ETyo7N5w&feature=youtu.be][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33592511/208363a652aaa0f12b61b5d287b74bc70bcf7d60.png[/img][/url]

[h1]General Game Mode Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Battle consists of 3 phases.
[*]  In each phase, strategic bomber flights are sent from the side of the escorting group. 
[*] Strongholds, sectors with powerful AA guns, appear on the way of the strategic bomber flight. AA guns are powerful enough to destroy all bombers in the flight if the escorting group does not take care of air defense.
[*] Strongholds initially belong to the intercepting group, but can be captured.
[*] Capturing the first Stronghold moves the respawn of the escorting group aircraft to this sector, allowing you to quickly return to battle and not waste time on a long flight from the initial respawn point.
[*] Sector re-capturing is impossible.
[*] The main goal of the escorting team is to escort [b]10[/b] strategic bombers to the targeted area.
[*] The main goal of the intercepting team is to prevent [b]10[/b] strategic bombers reaching the targeted area.
[*] [b]NB:[/b] if the number of strategic bombers left does not allow the escorting team to escort required number of strategic bombers (including all phases), the intercepting group wins.
[*] If all enemy aircraft are destroyed the team (either escorting or intercepting) wins as the number of respawns is limited.
[/list]
